visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short brown hair and round glasses wearing a cream-colored knit sweater sits at a bright red table in an indoor clinic setting. She holds a smartphone in her right hand, looking at the screen with a confused expression as yellow animated question marks float around her head. In the background, professional bags and certificates are visible on white cabinets. (2) Her expression shifts to shock and realization as a grey storm cloud with rain animation appears above her head, symbolizing a sudden negative realization. (3) She points her left index finger upward while displaying an Instagram post on her phone screen, which shows a person relaxing in a lounge chair at a sunny beach. A white text box appears on the left. (4) The woman's face is comically distorted using a 'funny face' filter with an enlarged mouth and eyes, while blue spiral animations and sweat drops appear around her head to convey distress or disbelief. (5) The screen transitions to a clean white background displaying the DRX Dermatology Clinic logo and detailed contact information, including social media handles, phone numbers, and two physical addresses in Traditional Chinese.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous 'POV' (Point of View) meme format to educate viewers about skin care after medical procedures. It depicts a dermatologist's reaction upon discovering a patient went on a sunny vacation immediately after a freckle removal treatment, highlighting the irony and medical concern through visual filters and dramatic effects, eventually leading to the clinic's contact information.
